question: Which frozen Fireflies four-condition parameters bind the equipped stack amount, cap and duration, and how does the source-supported team-hit rule execute in ordinary native builds?
stop_condition: Bind the frozen numeric parameters and execute source-supported team/off-field Anima hits for ordinary native builds, retaining explicit rejection of unsupported nearby-target geometry.
return_condition: New source consumer evidence can resolve actual proximity and multi-target geometry, stack refresh behavior, or replace the tested independent-expiry/no-refresh policy.
rationale: Frozen Suit2 four-condition binds Buff_Equipment_Nature2_4 and advertises eight percent CRIT DMG, seven stacks and ten-second duration. Its three coordinate-one curves serialize 0.08, 7 and 10. Treat the scalar as fractional bonus and CD as per-stack duration in seconds; this agrees with the description and existing independently expiring stack model. The frozen localized and Chinese descriptions both say a nearby enemy taking Anima damage from the Team grants stacks and explicitly retain the effect off-field. Ordinary native hit delivery therefore grants one stack per connected Anima packet to every living wearer, including off-field owners. Proximity is not quantified: one origin target at [0,0,0] remains the accepted geometry hypothesis; multi-target requests and displaced origin targets reject when a connected Anima packet reaches Fireflies.
affected_scenarios: Ordinary native studio/DSL builds with source-bound Suit2, team Anima packets, living Fireflies wearers on or off field, one target at the origin; the separate legacy native_mind_royale_fireflies_solo_v1 projector remains one actor, one origin target and native Anima invocations only.
limits: Numeric proximity/radius and multi-target geometry are unsupported; reached team Anima packets reject unless the scenario has one target at the origin.
Independent expiry, no refresh at cap and expiry-before-hit are executable model hypotheses; source consumers remain unverified.
Caller timing/costs, complete static/passive application and full character/gear coverage remain incomplete.
checks: Owning content and CLI source-mutation tests

Public mint/nanally/haniel native DSL scenario: independent seven-stack crit arithmetic, per-packet/two-wearer event count, delayed off-field source, non-Anima/zero/dead source/dead target/dead wearer exclusions, displaced/multiple-target rejection, Worker/CLI/WASM report parity
Strict model assumption exact-match, missing and mismatch checks; existing cap-without-refresh and expiry-before-equal-time-hit regressions
tools/verify_native_fireflies_projection.py remains scoped to the restricted legacy solo projection
